e.title: **在一次性云主机上跑 Oasis 模型，跑完就丢**：仓库 `OasisLMF/Alpaca`——**逐字自述目标是「**nothing is left behind to pay for**」**；**⭐ 四种运行类型**（**模型、**测试、**API、**基准**）**；**⭐ 其中**基准那一种**会把**同一个模型**放到**好几个 Oasis 版本或分支**上跑，**比较耗时与输出**；**⚠️ 而 README 特意写明一种**看起来像卡住**的失败形态**
e.title_en: A command line tool for running Oasis catastrophe models on throwaway cloud instances that are destroyed afterwards, offering four run types of which one benchmarks the same model across several Oasis versions or branches, and documenting a failure mode that looks like the tool is simply hanging.
e.title_hk: **在一次性雲主機上跑 Oasis 模型，跑完就丟**：倉庫 `OasisLMF/Alpaca`——**逐字自述目標是「**nothing is left behind to pay for**」**；**⭐ 四種運行類型**（**模型、**測試、**API、**基準**）**；**⭐ 其中**基準那一種**會把**同一個模型**放到**好幾個 Oasis 版本或分支**上跑，**比較耗時與輸出**；**⚠️ 而 README 特意寫明一種**看起來像卡住**的失敗形態**
e.summary: **alpaca-oasis-runner**（`OasisLMF/Alpaca`）**是一个**命令行工具**，**逐字自述用途为**「**a command line tool for running Oasis models on throwaway EC2 instances**」**，**目标逐字为**「**so nothing is left behind to pay for**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-01-14、最后推送 2026-09-09**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**；**许可 BSD 3-Clause**（**`LICENSE` 逐字** `Copyright (c) 2022 Oasis Loss Modelling Framework`**）**；**tarball 枚举 97 条路径**（**31 条测试条目、**`example_configs/` 5 份 JSON、**CI 跑 Python 3.12**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：把上游当成引擎、并且要真的跑起来**」**——**它的上游是本站已收录的 [[oasislmf]]，**而它自己**只管起机器、**发起运行、**收结果、**销毁机器**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **四种运行类型**（**逐字** `model`／`pytest`／`api`／`benchmark`**）**，**其中** `benchmark` **会把**同一个模型**放到**多个 Oasis 版本或分支**上跑并**比较耗时与输出**；**② **README 把一种**看起来像卡住**的失败形态写了出来****（**逐字**「**the failure looks like Alpaca waiting out its retries**」**）**；**③ **`alpaca create-config` 可按运行类型**交互式生成配置**。**⚠️ 需要真实 AWS 账号、**本次未运行**。
e.summary_hk: **alpaca-oasis-runner**（`OasisLMF/Alpaca`）**是一個**命令列工具**，**逐字自述用途為**「**a command line tool for running Oasis models on throwaway EC2 instances**」**，**目標逐字為**「**so nothing is left behind to pay for**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-01-14、最後推送 2026-09-09**、**★0**、**Python**；**許可 BSD 3-Clause**（`LICENSE` 逐字 `Copyright (c) 2022 Oasis Loss Modelling Framework`**）**；**tarball 列舉 97 條路徑**（**31 條測試條目、**`example_configs/` 5 份 JSON、**CI 跑 Python 3.12**）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**下游：把上游當成引擎、並且要真的跑起來**」**——**上游是本站已收錄的 [[oasislmf]]，**而它自己**只管起機器、**發起運行、**收結果、**銷毀機器**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得看**：**① **四種運行類型**（`model`／`pytest`／`api`／`benchmark`**）**，**其中** `benchmark` **把**同一個模型**放到**多個 Oasis 版本或分支**上跑並**比較耗時與輸出**；**② **README 把一種**看起來像卡住**的失敗形態寫了出來****（**逐字**「**the failure looks like Alpaca waiting out its retries**」**）**；**③ **`alpaca create-config` 可按運行類型**互動式生成配置**。**⚠️ 需要真實 AWS 帳號、**本次未運行**。
e.summary_en: The repository Alpaca **is a command line tool for running Oasis catastrophe models on throwaway cloud instances**, described verbatim as being for running Oasis models on throwaway EC2 instances so that nothing is left behind to pay for. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-01-14**, **last pushed 2026-09-09**, **zero stars**, primarily Python, **licensed BSD 3-Clause** with a licence file naming the Oasis Loss Modelling Framework as copyright holder, and **97 paths in the extracted archive**, including thirty-one test entries, five example configuration files, and continuous integration running on Python 3.12. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream treating the upstream as an engine that must actually be run**, since its upstream is the pooled Oasis loss-modelling framework while this tool only provisions a machine, launches a run, collects results and destroys the machine. **Three things are worth reading**: **four run types** are offered for a model, a test suite, an API deployment and a benchmark; **the benchmark type runs the same model across several Oasis versions or branches and compares timings and outputs**; the README **documents a failure mode that looks like the tool hanging**; and an interactive configuration command generates configuration by run type. **A real cloud account is required and nothing was run this round.**
e.body:
**Alpaca**（GitHub 仓库 `OasisLMF/Alpaca`）**是一个**命令行工具**，**README 逐字自述**「**A command line tool for running Oasis models on throwaway EC2 instances**」**，**并逐字给出目标**「**so nothing is left behind to pay for**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-01-14、最后推送 2026-09-09**、**★0**、**主语言 Python**；**许可 BSD 3-Clause**（**`LICENSE` 逐字** `Copyright (c) 2022 Oasis Loss Modelling Framework`**）**；**tarball 枚举 97 条路径**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：把上游当成引擎、并且要真的跑起来**」**——**它的上游是本站已收录的 [[oasislmf]]**，**⭐ 而它自己**不做损失计算**：**它只管**起机器、**发起运行、**把结果收回来、**再把机器销毁**。

**可核实信息（均 README、配置示例与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 四种运行类型，**并且每种干什么被写清****——**逐字为**：**① `model`**——**在云主机上跑** `oasislmf model run`**；**② `pytest`**——**跑测试**；**③ `api`**——**部署 Oasis 平台并**走 API 运行**；**④ `benchmark`**——**逐字**「**runs the same model across several OasisLMF versions/branches, comparing timings and outputs**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为本轮最值得抄的就是**第四种****：**「**同一个模型、**换上游版本、**再比一遍**」**——**⭐ 即**它把「**换了上游的哪个版本会怎样**」这件事**变成了一条命令**，**而不是**一句口头提醒**；**⭐ 这与本站第 342 轮「**逐部分声明**」、第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」同向**：**你能说清**你跑的是**哪一份上游**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把一种**看起来像卡住**的失败形态写进了 README**——**逐字**：**「**`AMI_ID` must ship SSM Agent + `ec2-instance-connect` (a stripped-down custom image may not, and **the failure looks like Alpaca waiting out its retries**)」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得记的一处**：**「**看起来像在等**」**其实是**镜像缺少两个组件**——**⭐ 而这种「**症状与原因相距很远**」的失败**，**如果作者不写出来，**使用者只会以为工具坏了**。**⭐ README 同时逐字给出默认等待量**：**`SSH_MAX_RETRIES` × 3 秒（**默认 60 次、**约 3 分钟**）**。**⭐⭐ ③ 连接方式改走 SSM，**且这个改动被写明****——**README 逐字说明**重连**now via SSM（**不再用** `.pem`**）**，**并要求** `IAM_INSTANCE_PROFILE` **带上** `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore`**，**同时逐字指出** `SECURITY_GROUP_ID` **不再需要开放入站 22 端口**。**⭐ 即**「**要给我什么权限**」**与**「**你不再需要开哪个端口**」**两件事都被说了**——**⭐ 这与本站第 334 轮「**边界即清单**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ④ 配置可以**交互式生成****——**README 逐字给出** `alpaca create-config`**（**按运行类型生成配置**）**；**文件清单实测** `example_configs/` **5 份 JSON**（**api、**benchmark 三份、**model 三份中**含 `piwind`**）**——**⭐ 而 [[oasis-piwind]] 已在本站收录**：**⭐ 即**示例配置用的正是那个**公开的示范模型**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程形态可数**：**包内** `alpaca/{api,benchmark,cli}/`**；**`pytest.ini`、**`ruff.toml`**；**`setup.py` 标明 Python 3.8 起**；**两个 workflow 逐字为** `.github/workflows/code-quality.yml` **与** `.github/workflows/unittest.yml`**，**而 CI 跑的是 Python 3.12**；**测试条目 31 条**。**⭐ 本词条如实指出一处**：**「**`setup.py` 的 Python 下限**」与「**CI 实际使用的 Python 版本**」**两者本次**未做交叉核实**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 基准运行的落盘位置被写明**——**README 说明 `benchmark` 在本地**读写 S3**；**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**本次**未读 `alpaca/benchmark/` **的实现**，**故**只主张 README 的这一说法**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[oasislmf]] 覆盖开放损失建模平台**，**[[oasis-piwind]] 覆盖公开示范模型**，**[[ods-open-exposure-data]] 覆盖开放暴露数据**，**[[oasis-risk-explorer]]、[[oasis-opendatatransform]] 覆盖平台周边**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**把平台放到一次性云主机上跑、**并把**跨版本基准**做成一种运行类型**」这一形态**。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[oasislmf]]、[[oasis-piwind]] 应当并读**——**前者给平台，**中者给可跑的公开模型，**本条给**怎么用一次性的机器把它跑起来**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的两点**：**① 把「**换上游版本再比一遍**」**做成一条命令**；**② 把「**看起来像卡住、**其实是缺组件**」这类失败形态**写进文档**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该项目任何一步**，**也未连接任何云账号**（**未起实例、**未跑 model／pytest／api／benchmark、**未生成任何计时或输出对比**），**故**不主张**它能跑通**，**也不主张**其基准结果。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何源码正文**——**本次只读** `README.md`、**配置示例的文件名与清单**、**以及 tarball 路径列表**；**未打开** `alpaca/` **下任何 `.py`**，**未读** `example_configs/` **内 5 份 JSON 的正文**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实 README 所述四种运行类型是否与源码一一对应**；**未核实** `SSH_MAX_RETRIES` **的默认值在代码里确为 60**（**⭐ 本词条只转述 README 的「**默认约 3 分钟**」这一说法**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实 `AMI_ID`／`IAM_INSTANCE_PROFILE`／`SECURITY_GROUP_ID` **这些环境变量的**完整必填清单****（**⭐ 只记 README 点名的几个**）**；**也未核实** SSM **是否需要额外安装本地插件**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实「**benchmark 在本地读写 S3**」**的具体含义****（**是**下载到本地再比**，**还是**通过本地凭据直接读写远端**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实 `LICENSE` 中**第三条款**的正文**（**只读到版权行**）**，**也未核实 `setup.py` 中是否另有许可声明**。**⑦ ⚠️ 该工具会**创建并销毁云资源、**并产生费用****——**⭐ 本词条如实提示**：**本条目**不是使用邀请**，**使用前**须自读其 README 的权限与清理说明**。**⑧ ⚠️ ★0、**无独立验证**；**本条目**不主张其可靠性、**不主张其已被任何机构用于生产**。**⑨ ⚠️ 创建 2026-01-14 在解冻窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之内**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是「**把开放损失建模平台放到一次性基础设施上跑 ＋ 把跨版本基准做成一种运行类型 ＋ 把看起来像卡住的失败形态写进文档**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**。

**Alpaca**（GitHub 倉庫 `OasisLMF/Alpaca`）**是一個**命令列工具**，**README 逐字自述**「**A command line tool for running Oasis models on throwaway EC2 instances**」**，**並逐字給出目標**「**so nothing is left behind to pay for**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-01-14、最後推送 2026-09-09**、**★0**、**Python**；**許可 BSD 3-Clause**（`LICENSE` 逐字 `Copyright (c) 2022 Oasis Loss Modelling Framework`**）**；**tarball 列舉 97 條路徑**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**下游：把上游當成引擎、並且要真的跑起來**」**——**上游是本站已收錄的 [[oasislmf]]**，**⭐ 而它自己**不做損失計算**：**只管**起機器、**發起運行、**收結果、**銷毀機器**。

**可核實資訊（均 README、配置示例與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 四種運行類型，**且每種幹什麼被寫清****——**逐字為** `model`（**在雲主機上跑** `oasislmf model run`**）、`pytest`、`api`（**部署 Oasis 平台並走 API 運行**）、`benchmark`（**逐字**「**runs the same model across several OasisLMF versions/branches, comparing timings and outputs**」**）**。**⭐ 本詞條認為本輪最值得抄的就是**第四種****：**「**同一個模型、**換上游版本、**再比一遍**」**——**⭐ 即**把「**換了上游哪個版本會怎樣**」**變成了一條命令**；**⭐ 這與本站第 342 輪「**逐部分聲明**」同向**：**你能說清**你跑的是**哪一份上游**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 它把一種**看起來像卡住**的失敗形態寫進了 README**——**逐字**：**「**`AMI_ID` must ship SSM Agent + `ec2-instance-connect` (a stripped-down custom image may not, and the failure looks like Alpaca waiting out its retries)」**。**⭐ 本詞條認為這是本輪最值得記的一處**：**「**看起來像在等**」**其實是**鏡像缺少兩個組件**——**⭐ 這種「**症狀與原因相距很遠**」的失敗**，**作者不寫出來，**使用者只會以為工具壞了**。**⭐ README 同時逐字給出預設等待量**：**`SSH_MAX_RETRIES` × 3 秒（**預設 60 次、**約 3 分鐘**）**。**⭐⭐ ③ 連接方式改走 SSM，**且這個改動被寫明****——**逐字**重連**now via SSM（**不再用** `.pem`**）**，**要求** `IAM_INSTANCE_PROFILE` **帶上** `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore`**，**並逐字指出** `SECURITY_GROUP_ID` **不再需要開放入站 22 埠**。**⭐ 即**「**要給我什麼權限**」**與**「**你不再需要開哪個埠**」**都被說了**。**⭐⭐ ④ 配置可**互動式生成****——**逐字** `alpaca create-config`**；**`example_configs/` 實測 5 份 JSON**（**api、**benchmark 三份、**model 三份中**含 `piwind`**）**——**⭐ 而 [[oasis-piwind]] 已在本站收錄**：**示例配置用的正是那個**公開示範模型**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 工程形態可數**：**包內** `alpaca/{api,benchmark,cli}/`**、**`pytest.ini`、**`ruff.toml`**；**`setup.py` 標明 Python 3.8 起**；**兩個 workflow 逐字為** `.github/workflows/code-quality.yml` **與** `.github/workflows/unittest.yml`**，**CI 跑 Python 3.12**；**測試條目 31 條**。**⭐ 如實指出一處**：**`setup.py` 的 Python 下限**與** CI 實際版本**本次**未交叉核實**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 基準運行的落盤位置被寫明**——**README 說明 `benchmark` 在本地**讀寫 S3**；**⭐ 本次**未讀 `alpaca/benchmark/` 實現**，**只主張 README 這一說法**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[oasislmf]]、[[oasis-piwind]]、[[ods-open-exposure-data]]、[[oasis-risk-explorer]]、[[oasis-opendatatransform]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**把平台放到一次性雲主機上跑、**並把**跨版本基準**做成運行類型**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[oasislmf]]、[[oasis-piwind]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 兩點最值得借鑑**：**① 把「**換上游版本再比一遍**」**做成命令**；**② 把「**看起來像卡住、**其實是缺組件**」這類失敗形態**寫進文檔**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行該專案任何一步**，**也未連接任何雲帳號**（**未起實例、**未跑 model／pytest／api／benchmark**），**故**不主張**它能跑通**，**也不主張**其基準結果**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何原始碼正文**——**只讀** `README.md`、**配置示例的檔名與清單**、**tarball 路徑列表**；**未打開** `alpaca/` **下任何 `.py`**，**未讀** `example_configs/` **內 5 份 JSON 正文**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實四種運行類型是否與原始碼一一對應**；**未核實** `SSH_MAX_RETRIES` **在代碼裡確為 60**（**只轉述 README 的「**預設約 3 分鐘**」**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實環境變數的**完整必填清單**；**未核實** SSM **是否需要額外安裝本地外掛**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實「**benchmark 在本地讀寫 S3**」**的具體含義**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實** `LICENSE` **第三條款正文**（**只讀到版權行**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 該工具會**建立並銷毀雲資源、**並產生費用****——**本條目**不是使用邀請**，**使用前**須自讀其 README 的權限與清理說明**。**⑧ ⚠️ ★0、**無獨立驗證**；**不主張其可靠性、**不主張其已被任何機構用於生產**。**⑨ ⚠️ 建立 2026-01-14 在解凍窗口之外、推送 2026-09-09 在窗口之內**——**本條的缺口是「把開放損失建模平台放到一次性基礎設施上跑＋把跨版本基準做成運行類型＋把看起來像卡住的失敗形態寫進文檔」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**。

e.body_en:
Alpaca, on GitHub under the Oasis loss-modelling organisation, **is a command line tool for running Oasis models on throwaway cloud instances**, described verbatim as being for running Oasis models on throwaway EC2 instances with the stated goal that nothing is left behind to pay for. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-01-14**, **last pushed 2026-09-09**, **zero stars**, primarily Python, **licensed BSD 3-Clause** with a licence file naming the Oasis Loss Modelling Framework as copyright holder, and **97 paths in the extracted archive**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream treating the upstream as an engine that must actually be run**: its upstream is the pooled Oasis loss-modelling framework, and this tool performs no loss calculation itself, only provisioning a machine, launching a run, collecting results and destroying the machine.

**Verified information, all measured from the README, the example configuration listing and the file listing**: **first, four run types are offered with a stated role for each** — a model type that runs the Oasis model command on the cloud machine, a test type, an API type that deploys the Oasis platform and runs through its API, and a benchmark type described verbatim as running the same model across several Oasis versions or branches while comparing timings and outputs. **This entry considers the fourth the most copyable item of the round: running the same model against a different upstream version and comparing again is turned into a single command rather than a verbal reminder**, which points the same way as standing project principles that a contribution should be declared part by part and that a source should be distinguishable from what it generated, since you can state exactly which upstream revision you ran. **Second, a failure mode that looks like hanging is written into the README**: verbatim, the instance image must ship the SSM agent and the instance-connect package, a stripped-down custom image may not, and **the failure looks like Alpaca waiting out its retries**. **That is the detail this entry most wants to remember: what looks like waiting is actually two missing components in the image, and if the author had not written it down, a user would only conclude that the tool is broken.** The README also states the default wait verbatim as a retry count times three seconds, sixty attempts and roughly three minutes by default. **Third, the connection method moved to SSM and the change is documented**: the README states verbatim that reconnection is now through SSM rather than a key file, requires the instance profile to carry a named managed policy, and states verbatim that the security group no longer needs inbound port twenty-two. **Both what permissions must be granted and which port is no longer needed are therefore written down**, matching the standing principle that a boundary should be a list. **Fourth, configuration can be generated interactively**: the README gives an interactive create-config command that generates configuration by run type, and the file listing shows five example configuration files across the API, benchmark and model types, including the publicly available demonstration model that is itself already pooled. **The examples therefore use exactly that public demonstration model.** **Fifth, the engineering shape is countable**: the package holds separate API, benchmark and command-line subpackages; there is a pytest configuration and a linter configuration; the packaging script states a Python floor of 3.8; two continuous-integration workflows cover code quality and unit tests and run on Python 3.12; and there are thirty-one test entries. **This entry states plainly that the Python floor in the packaging script and the version actually used in continuous integration were not cross-checked.** **Sixth, where benchmark artefacts land is stated**: the README says the benchmark type reads and writes S3 locally; **no benchmark implementation was read, so this entry relays the README statement only**. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the open loss-modelling platform, its public demonstration model, open exposure data and platform companions, **while this entry supplies running the platform on disposable infrastructure and turning cross-version benchmarking into a run type**.

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled Oasis platform and its public demonstration model**, which supply the platform and a runnable public model while this one supplies how to run it on disposable machines; **two practices transfer directly: turn running the same model against a different upstream version into a single command, and write failure modes that look like hanging but are actually missing components into the documentation**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run and no cloud account was touched** — no instance launched, no run type exercised, no timing or output comparison produced — **so this entry does not claim that it works, nor does it claim any benchmark result**. **Second, no source code was read**: only the README, the names and listing of the example configuration files and the archive path list were read, and no Python file under the package directory and no example configuration body was opened; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the four stated run types map one-to-one onto the source was not verified, and the stated default retry count was not confirmed in code, this entry relaying only the README statement of roughly three minutes.** **Fourth, the complete set of required environment variables was not verified**, only the few the README names, nor was it verified whether the SSM route needs an additional local plugin. **Fifth, the precise meaning of reading and writing S3 locally in the benchmark type was not verified.** **Sixth, the third clause of the licence was not read**, only the copyright line, nor was it checked whether the packaging script carries a separate licence declaration. **Seventh, this tool creates and destroys cloud resources and incurs cost, so this entry is not an invitation to use it: read its README on permissions and cleanup first.** **Eighth, it has zero stars and no independent verification, and this entry claims neither reliability nor production use by any institution. Ninth, the creation date of 2026-01-14 is outside the thaw window while the push of 2026-09-09 is inside it**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that running an open loss-modelling platform on disposable infrastructure, turning cross-version benchmarking into a run type, and documenting a failure that looks like hanging had no counterpart in the pool. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11.**
